g.text: Funding documents talk about justice; laws and disclosures do not

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Share of each corpus's own body-text passages carrying each justice label, so corpus size is divided out.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Shading runs light to dark with that percentage, scaled within each column — the three classifiers have very different

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: base rates, given under each heading. Compare shades down a column, not across one.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Litigation is omitted entirely: all three classifier specs carry dont_run_on: ["sabin"] and every published Litigation document is a Sabin record, so no inference was ever run there.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: Climate Policy Radar, PRODUCTION.PUBLISHED.PASSAGES (Snowflake), Aug 2026. Body text passages only (content_type='Text', >=20 chars), published non-principal documents.
